mapper.select: select a.album_id, a.member_id, a.product_id, a.title, a.travel_date, a.cover, a.media_json, a.description, a.status, a.create_time, a.update_time, m.nickname as member_name, p.title as product_title from hys_album a left join hys_member m on m.member_id = a.member_id left join hys_product p on p.product_id = a.product_id where a.album_id = #{albumId}
mapper.insert: insert into hys_album (member_id, product_id, title, travel_date, cover, media_json, description, status, create_time, update_time) values (#{memberId}, #{productId}, #{title}, #{travelDate}, #{cover}, #{mediaJson}, #{description}, #{status}, now(), now())
